item.title: Version 1.1.8 (macOS)
item.description:
v1.1.8 — Local imports, Trash, and fixes

  • Import local PDFs: paste a file path in the search bar, or drag & drop a PDF — both now extract the title and file it into your library (drag-drop used to be a plain copy)
  • Right-click → Open PDF is now a submenu: Open in app · Open with system default · Open with…
  • Delete moves the PDF to the Trash (recoverable), and a restored file reappears instead of staying stuck
  • Empty folders now show in the sidebar
  • Fixed: importing or downloading a paper no longer makes the window vanish

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
v1.1.0 — Auto-Update System

  • Auto-update checking via Sparkle 2
  • Update notification badge on settings icon
  • About section in Settings with version info
  • PDF viewer right-click context menu
  • Fix Google/GitHub OAuth in release builds
  • DMG installer with drag-to-Applications
